items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Could that drummer been Bert Dollinger, Cliff?

ctx.x: ... the intermission piano player at Condon's for several years was Ralph Sutton, and he just loved Ralph. So he hired Ralph to be our piano player at that first party -- so that was the band. Ralph Sutton, Cutty Cutshall, Wild Bill Davis son, Edmund Hall, Jack Lesberg on bass. Then he hired one other group, which was Teddy Wilson's trio. And that's all the music he had. Teddy Wilson's trio ...
Who was in his trio? Can you remember? Could that drummer been Bert Dollinger, Cliff?
